      Meet the People Behind Phin

      The people who bring our coffee, food and hospitality to life every day.

      Meet the Phin Coffee Hoi An Team

      The Phin Coffee Hoi An team has grown alongside us, from one small coffee shop in Hoi An to restaurants, a roastery and coffee experiences. Along the way, Phin has been shaped by the people who have cooked, brewed, roasted, served, learned and grown with us.

      Some have been with us for years, others are newer to the team, but each person plays a part in what guests experience when they visit Phin.

      Different roles. Different personalities. One Phin team.

      The People Who Started Phin

      Anh Vuong

      Operations • People • Finance

      Anh is behind much of the day-to-day life of Phin, managing our operations, finances and teams across the different locations. As Phin has grown, she has helped turn one small coffee shop into the group we have today.

      Thinh Bui

      Coffee • Roasting • Experiences

      Thinh’s background in tourism took him across Vietnam, where his interest in Vietnamese coffee continued to grow. Today, he focuses on roasting, developing Phin’s coffee program and sharing Vietnamese coffee through our classes and experiences.

      Different roles, but Phin has always been something we’ve built together.

      The Kitchen Team — Behind Our Food

      Our food starts with the people in our kitchen. They bring experience with Hoi An and Central Vietnamese cooking, the flavours they grew up with, and an understanding of the ingredients we use every day.

      They are also part of how our menu continues to evolve. Traditional dishes are cooked with respect for where they come from, while other dishes grow through experimenting, tasting and working on new ideas together.

      From Cao Lầu and Mì Quảng to our smoked dishes and Phin creations, the kitchen team is behind the food that reaches the table.

      Meet Our Coffee Experience Team

      Our coffee experiences are led by people who work with Vietnamese coffee every day. From our hands-on Easy Coffee Class to the more in-depth Vietnamese Coffee Master Class and Roaster A Day experience, our instructors share their knowledge in a relaxed, practical and personal way.

      My Hi

      Coffee Class Instructor

      Passionate, friendly and regularly praised by guests for making Vietnamese coffee easy and enjoyable to learn.

      Ngọc (Mint)

      Coffee Class Instructor

      Known for her clear, informative teaching and for guiding guests through Vietnamese coffee beans, brewing and traditional drinks.

      Yến

      Easy Coffee Class Instructor

      Guides guests through our hands-on Easy Coffee Class, sharing Vietnamese brewing techniques and helping guests make some of Phin’s signature coffee drinks.

      Thinh Bui

      Founder • Coffee Roaster • Master Class Instructor

      Leads our Vietnamese Coffee Master Class and Roaster A Day experience, taking guests deeper into Vietnamese coffee, tasting, processing and roasting.

      One Team Across Phin

      Behind our restaurants, coffee bars, kitchen and coffee experiences is a much bigger team. They are the people welcoming guests, preparing drinks, serving tables, keeping our spaces running and helping each Phin location feel like its own place.

      Some have been part of Phin for years, while others have joined us more recently. Together, they are the people who have helped Phin grow from one small coffee shop into what it is today.

      Coffee • Kitchen • Service • Experiences • Operations — One Phin Team
